title: The Story CD Too High on the Shelf
youtube_title: The Story CD Too High on the Shelf | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small useful favor can be louder than a big speech.
summary: At a market lane of baskets, jars, and flower pots, a story disc on the high shelf is awkward for one person. Golda notices Grandma Nia struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
